Methods

ExtractCommandName(string, string, out int)

Extracts the command name from a message string that starts with a specified prefix.

public string ExtractCommandName(string message, string prefix, out int consumed)

Parameters

message string

The input message string containing the command and its arguments.

prefix string

The prefix that precedes the command in the message. This is used to identify the start of the command.

consumed int

When this method returns, contains the number of characters consumed from the message, including the prefix and the command name. This parameter is passed uninitialized.

Returns

string

The extracted command name as a string. If the message contains no arguments after the command, the entire remaining portion of the message after the prefix is returned.

Remarks

This method assumes that the input message starts with the specified prefix. If the prefix is not present, the behavior is undefined. The method also trims the prefix and extracts the first word (delimited by a space) as the command name. If no space is found, the entire remaining message is treated as the command name.

GetCommand(string, bool, bool)

Retrieves a command by name from the client or server command collections, based on the specified options.

public OnixCommandBase? GetCommand(string name, bool includeClient, bool includeServer)

Parameters

name string

The name of the command to retrieve. The comparison is case-insensitive.

includeClient bool

A value indicating whether to search the client command collection. If true, the client commands are searched.

includeServer bool

A value indicating whether to search the server command collection. If true, the server commands are searched.

Returns

OnixCommandBase

The command with the specified name, if found in the selected collections; otherwise, null.

RegisterCommand(OnixCommandBase)

Registers a command that will be able to be executed.

public void RegisterCommand(OnixCommandBase command)

Parameters

command OnixCommandBase

UnregisterCommand(OnixCommandBase)

Unregisters the specified command from the system, removing it from the appropriate execution targets.

public void UnregisterCommand(OnixCommandBase command)

Parameters

command OnixCommandBase

The command to unregister. This cannot be null.

Remarks

The method removes the command from the client-side, server-side, or both, depending on the CommandExecutionTarget specified in the command. If the command is registered for both client and server execution, it will be removed from both contexts. After the command is unregistered, the OnCommandUnregistered(OnixCommandBase) method is invoked to handle any additional cleanup or notifications.
